lines: A cleric joke is like medicine: if it tastes pleasant, check it twice.
Remedies jokes need timing. Mine usually arrive with breath on them.
I keep a spare joke near the brewing stand. It is not always ready for public use.
I told a joke at the brewing stand once. The workstation took it better than the villagers did.
Cleric jokes are best taken with water.
I had a potion joke, but the side effects were mostly groaning.
My brewing stand makes better bubbles than punchlines.
A healing joke should land softly and leave no scar.
I know an omen joke, but it is only funny after it does not happen.
The chapel has <gold><pulse>excellent</pulse></gold> acoustics for awkward silence.
I told a herb joke once. It needed more thyme.
A potion walked into the room and immediately improved everyone's posture.
My best sermon joke lasted too long, like many sermons.
I asked the candle for humor. It gave me a flicker of hope.
A bandage joke wraps up neatly if you are patient.
The brewing stand hissed at my last joke. Fair review.
I know a joke about bad luck, but I refuse to test it indoors.
If laughter is medicine, some villagers insist on a tiny dose.
I tried a serious joke once. It became advice by accident.
